Subject: Sustainers Summit — request for maintainer credit and trial extension

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for taking my call last week. OpenSource Foundry is running our first Sustainers Summit (Sep 20-21) — it’s a low-cost, invite-first weekend focused on funding and tooling for open-source maintainers. We expect ~120 registrants and are reserving 30 maintainer seats (we vet them).

Could Redwood support the event with: 1) promo credits for up to 30 maintainers (we’d like each maintainer to receive a one-time token credit to try Redwood during the sprint), and 2) a trial extension for newly created accounts (we usually ask for 4–6 weeks).

Attached is a short agenda and our sponsorship request doc. Ideal timeline: we need a confirmation and the mechanics (coupon codes or redemption flow) by Aug 30 to include in the welcome email.

Key asks:
- Credits for 30 maintainers (we’re flexible on denomination — either per-token or a fixed $ equivalent)
- Trial extension (4–6 weeks)
- A short blurb we can include in the event email mentioning Redwood support

Appreciate any help — happy to hop on a 20m call if that’s easier.

Best,
Elena Soto
Program Director, OpenSource Foundry

Thanks for forwarding — I like supporting maintainers here. A couple of clarifying questions before I OK anything:

1) Eligibility: Are the 30 seats strictly vetted maintainers (i.e., owners/maintainers of open-source projects with >100 stars or active monthly contributors)? We should limit to prevent gaming.
2) Amount: I propose a conservative package: $100 equivalent credit per maintainer (applied to token usage) plus a 6-week trial extension. If they use it up in the sprint, they can upgrade. Does that sound reasonable?
3) Tracking: We should issue unique coupon codes tied to the event and a single redemption window (Sep 20–Oct 31). Can we require them to fill a short form to get the code so we can tie to emails/HubSpot?

If everyone is comfortable, I can greenlight and attach the approved sheet.

- Lauren
